name: The Shikoku Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Shikoku Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various commercial banking products and services in Japan. It offers accumulated fixed, term, and foreign currency deposits; car, education renovation, purpose, free, pension free, and owner's free loans; free and education cards; and loan simulation and loan plaza services, as well as credit, and cash cards. The company also provides payment, ATM lottery, inheritance related, foreign currency, internet banking, and convenience store ATM services; business succession consulting services; merger and acquisition mediation support services; and business matching and SDGs management support services.
